title: pncA and pyrazinamide
dek: No tidy RRDR. PZA resistance is a scattered pncA loss-of-function plus rare panD/clpC1 stories. Sequence the whole gene, including the promoter. M. bovis is born resistant.
story: Pyrazinamide is a prodrug. PncA (pyrazinamidase/nicotinamidase) converts it to pyrazinoic acid (POA). POA’s target story is still messier than INH’s (CoA metabolism, panD, acidified POA accumulation), but the resistance genetics in clinic are dominated by pncA coding and promoter mutations scattered across the gene.

There is no 81-bp PZA cassette. A five-probe cartridge cannot do this gene. tNGS panels that drop pncA amplicons must not report PZA-S. Silent phylogenetic pncA SNPs exist and are graded not-associated in the catalogue — do not regex the gene name.
M. bovis and BCG carry an ancestral pncA lesion (commonly His57Asp). That is intrinsic PZA-R, not acquired MDR. H37Rv is PZA-S; it is the coordinate origin, not M. bovis.
deepTitle: Phenotype is pH, genotype is scattered
deep: PZA MGIT at the wrong pH is a false-R factory. Discordance with a WT pncA should make you check the pH, not invent a new gene first.
panD and clpC1 alleles are real but uncommon compared with pncA. Catalogue-grade them; do not let them drown the report.
POA efflux (some Rv1258c stories) is not the first place a clinical lab should look.
PZA is a sterilizing companion in DS-TB and in several 9-month DR recipes. A wrecked pncA means you lost a month-count, not a footnote.

visual.caption: pncA is short and mean: resistance alleles scatter across the CDS and promoter. Contrast with rpoB’s RRDR hotspot. H57 is the bovis intrinsic mark.

example.title: pncA synonymous lineage SNP called R
example.setup: TBProfiler flags pncA. The change is a known lineage marker graded not-associated. Phenotypic PZA is S.

steps.title: Read the grade
steps.body: Gene name ≠ resistance. Catalogue not-associated alleles stay S.

steps.title: Do not “confirm” with a bad MGIT
steps.body: If someone then runs PZA at pH 6.8 and gets R, you have two errors stacked.

steps.title: Keep looking if phenotype is truly R and pncA is honestly WT
steps.body: Then panD/clpC1 and lab pH enter. That is a residual, not a regex failure.

example.takeaway: pncA needs the whole gene and a grade, not a hit/no-hit.

check.prompt: Why can’t a five-probe RRDR-style cartridge cover PZA well?
choices: Because pncA is on a plasmid
Because clinically relevant pncA mutations are scattered across the gene/promoter, not confined to an 81-bp cassette
Because PZA is not a drug
check.answer: Because clinically relevant pncA mutations are scattered across the gene/promoter, not confined to an 81-bp cassette
check.why: Whole-gene interrogation is the design implication.

check.prompt: M. bovis BCG pncA H57D should be reported as:
choices: Intrinsic PZA resistance of the bovis lineage, not treatment-emergent MDR
check.answer: Intrinsic PZA resistance of the bovis lineage, not treatment-emergent MDR
